prepare_hqq_linear_quantization: prepare a HuggingFace transformer model for HQQ quantization by attaching quantization configs to linear layers
autoname_model_modules: autoname all modules inside a PyTorch model so each module gets a name attribute for later reference
extract_linear_tags_from_model: extract linear tags from a PyTorch model to identify quantizable linear layer groups
map_quantization_params_to_layers: map quantization parameters to specific linear layer tags so each layer type gets its own HQQ config
skip_modules_from_quantization: skip specified module types and modules from HQQ quantization while preparing a model for quantization
